caption: Prespa Lakes, Prespa
composition: Psarades shore opening onto Great Prespa · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On the Psarades shoreline, stone fishing houses step up a juniper slope beside a small jetty and two boats. Reeds edge the water, and Great Prespa opens toward dark mountains. Cloud cover is about 19%, about 11.7°C. The sun is still below the horizon. A few windows are lit. The shore is not floodlit.
